name: Investment and Financial Management
description:
The optional exercise class accompanies the lecture "Investment and Financial Management: Introduction to Financial Markets" and provides students with the opportunity to deepen their understanding of the concepts introduced in the lecture through practical applications and problem-solving.

The exercise sessions cover the following topics:

- Bond valuation and pricing
- Stock valuation and pricing
- Investor decision-making and risk preferences
- Risk and return calculations
- Portfolio theory and diversification
- Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) and multifactor models
- Mutual funds and portfolio performance evaluation
- Introduction to financial derivatives and their valuation

Participation in the exercise sessions is voluntary.
prerequisites:
Recommended background:
- "Mathematics in Natural and Economic Science 1" or any equivalent mathematical background
- "Introduction to Data Science and Statistical Thinking" or any equivalent statistical background

Additional helpful background:
- "Economics I – Microeconomics"
- "Financial Accounting / Cost Accounting"
